extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to Nordic funding (individuals and organisations seeking grants, tenders or project funding)
extracted.subtask_description: Finding and applying for funding offered through Nordic cooperation, including searching open calls, grants and public procurements and following the relevant application procedures. The page acts as a gateway to specific calls and notes high-level administrative variations applicants must check.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search funding options
rubrics_metrics.description: “You can also search the options for grants, invitations to tender and calls for applications and find just the right type of funding for your project.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the site search/filters to locate suitable funding instruments (grants, invitations to tender, calls for applications) that match your project. The page is positioned as an index to find the appropriate funding type before proceeding to specific calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deadlines, grant nature and responsible body
rubrics_metrics.description: “Please note that the deadlines, the nature of the grants and who is responsible for them varies with the different types of funding.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed opportunity, verify the specific deadline, the kind/conditions of the grant (e.g., grant vs. procurement vs. open call), and which Nordic body or contact is responsible, since these differ across funding types and affect eligibility and application process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognise opportunity categories
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists opportunity categories such as “Open calls”, “Grants”, and “Public procurements.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of the category a listing belongs to (open call, grant, public procurement) because category determines procedure, documentation, and potentially eligibility and evaluation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor new and current opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: The page presents a chronological list of funding opportunities (dates and titles) and a “Show more” navigation to view additional entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regularly check the listing (or use the newsletter) to catch newly published calls and tenders; review each entry for its specific application instructions and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe for updates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to the newsletter to receive updates on new calls and funding opportunities rather than relying solely on periodic manual checks of the page.
